connect.title: Connect your tools
connect.intro: Most vendors already use other apps. Here's honestly what works with Wedded today, and what's coming.

google.name: Google Calendar
google.body: Your busy times will show as taken on your page. Wedded only sees busy or free, never what's in your events.

calendarLink.name: Apple, Outlook or Acuity
calendarLink.body: Paste your calendar's private link and we'll check it every hour, so it's close to live but never instant.

throughGoogle.name: Square, Calendly or Vagaro
throughGoogle.body: Turn on their Google Calendar sync and their bookings come through Google. Square needs its Plus or Premium plan for that.

booksy.name: Booksy
booksy.body: Booksy only opens to its own partners, so it can't connect. Mark booked days on your calendar instead.

instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.body: Your photos and reels will come in without uploading them again. For business or creator accounts, once Meta approves Wedded.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.body: Your public videos will play on your page, straight from TikTok, once TikTok approves Wedded.

link.name: Your page link
link.body: Put it in your Instagram bio or on your website, and families can ask you from anywhere.

website.name: Your website
website.body: Wed will read your site and suggest photos, prices and words for your page. Nothing goes live until you say yes.

connect.footer: Square, Acuity, Calendly and Vagaro can all copy bookings into Google Calendar, so connecting Google will cover them too.
